━━━ Pay · how to pay ━━━
(edits message 42)
💸 Pay another player
• In a group: reply to their message with "pay 5000".
• Here: send "pay" with their username or player code, for example "pay @username" or "pay K7Q2M9A".
Cash changes hands only when you are both in the same city; card payments work from anywhere.
  ───
  [🔎 Find a player] → social:search
  [🔙 Back] → bank:show
